editions.name: Cloud Server Edition
editions.description: Pure-Rust autonomous cloud appliance. Eliminates Docker, containerd, and systemd. Features Landlock LSM sandboxing, ferro-superd Cgroup v2 supervisor (2.66 MB RAM), and ferrocage sub-2ms micro-containers. Tested in $12 challenge.

editions.name: Desktop & Web Edition
editions.description: Pure-Rust graphical desktop stack. GPU Wayland compositor with Dual-Kawase acrylic blur, lightweight framebuffer window manager (/dev/fb0), XDG desktop portal, and remote HTML5 Web Desktop streaming (port 6080).

editions.name: Gaming & Proton Edition
editions.description: Real-time gaming performance engine. Sched_ext GameMode scheduling (500µs slice, <50µs jitter), automatic Nice -10 CPU priority, Vulkan DXVK/VKD3D mapping, PE/MSI binary inspection, and Wine/Proton/Box64 compatibility.

editions.name: AS/400 Enterprise Edition
editions.description: High-throughput parallel enterprise batch processing. Multi-worker ledger queues, 5250 green-screen terminal emulation over web/telnet, continuous ACID ledger journaling, and automated payroll/inventory reconciliations.
